signature: A flat, greyscale tropical island floating deep in a starry void: smoke-grey sand that drifts past the rim and hangs there with motionless rocks, dark crags that are the tips of an upturned rocky pyramid underneath, a towering forest that never sways in the constant wind, dormant houses with empty beds and closed blinds, and at the exact centre a ring of benches around a single trapdoor. Nothing here changes.

exits.to_label: The halls that echo (return; not numbered in the source)
exits.label: Opened the single trapdoor among the benches and went back down to the echoing halls
exits.source_quote: The only method of exit is to return to the echoing halls through venturing to the epicenter of the unchanging landmass
exits.hint: Everything on the island is the same in every direction, except the very middle.

entity_policy: NONE. The page names no entities; nothing is spawned.
notes: SOURCE: floating tropical island in a starry, space-like void; desaturating aura (greyscale), bleaching on extended stays; cold; smoke-grey fine sand drifting out past the perimeter and holding in the void; rocks floating motionless outside reach; grey palms and much darker rocks jutting from the sand, part of the unseen underside (a large irregular upturned rocky pyramid), immovable; coarse still dirt without grass inland; thick, hopelessly flat forest of old trees that never sway despite the constant ethereal wind; constant semi-illuminant aura (brightness unaffected by the canopy); sparse dormant houses of concrete, glass, wood and stone near the epicentre with no paths, dark dank rectangular insides, empty beds, closed blinds, sparse furniture; nothing changes; the only exit is a single trapdoor among benches at the epicentre, back to the echoing halls. ADAPTATION: island ~240 m across (radius 104-142 m) with ~600 procedural trees and ~70 palms; four houses (one per named material) placed 34-57 m from the centre, the wooden one with an upper storey and the glass one with a raised sleeping platform (natural vertical variation on a canonically flat page); soil banked against their walls shows them settling into the dirt; a ring of ten park benches; the arrival from the echoing halls is placed on the west beach because the page does not say where on the island one appears. The colour drains over nine seconds on arrival; total time spent is saved as 'bleach' and after ten minutes the colour never returns on arrival (the page: items and people inhabiting the level for extended periods are believed bleached). Six descriptive attempts to change things (rock, tree, blinds, bed, sand, bench) do nothing and end in the page's 'nothing of value'. Past the rim an invisible floor of held sand slows you and stops you 6 m out (the page gives no rule for entering the void; the soft limit follows its sand that 'holds in the void'). The echoing halls are linked on the page but their level number is not stated, so the exit target stays EXT. No notes, items, entities or colour, per the page's 'nothing to take away'. QA mode skips the colour drain and the rim hold so stills and the walker bot are deterministic. Canon: docs/canon/levels/L999.md; page by Greggita Mahayfaio, CC BY-SA 3.0.
